en: Black-and-white winter scene showing a group of skiers moving uphill on a snowy slope toward a large, wooden boarding house or guesthouse. Deep snow covers the ground and the roofs of the main building and a smaller structure behind it. Cross‑country ski tracks lead from the foreground to the house. A tall flagpole with a flag stands to the right, and leafless trees and forested hills appear in the background. Printed captions in Norwegian identify the place and photographer.
